title: Ecological Calibration Schema
description: Configuration schema for the empirical aggregate baseline calibration

numerator.description: State-wise PM Surya Ghar residential installation counts

denominator.description: Total state-wise eligible residential electricity consumers or HCES expansion sum

features.description: Household predictors (e.g., log_mpce, household_size, sector, dwelling_type, free_electricity)

weighting.description: Multiplier field used strictly for state-level aggregation

objective.description: Loss function evaluating predicted aggregate count vs observed state count

state_effects.description: Heterogeneity assumption. Recommended: None (pooled feature dependence)
